scope: Original local-audio-assist Resources channel; no JARVIS voice expansion or device access on development Mac.

source.runtime_rule: Version string is insufficient. Protected capture backend artifact/source receipt plus actually loaded sounddevice, CFFI and PortAudio runtime/module closure and current capture controller process proof are independently resolved. Do not invent PortAudio binary hash from the Python sdist.

selection.active_source: Existing AudioIngressSelection and root selected native-input ingress binding; exact profile/owner generation/device enrollment/session policy/format and enclosing nonrecursive service generation digest. No worker device name/index or boolean authorizes capture.
selection.identity: SHA256(canonical UTF-8 JSON object with index,name,host_api,max_input_channels,default_samplerate; sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False). This is current PortAudio enumeration identity, not a permanent physical serial number.
selection.enumeration: query_devices() and query_hostapis() with no default selection; show only valid input-capable records to actual foreground root TTY. Explicit numeric index choice; host API association must match. Re-enumerate exact tuple before session and immediately before stream open; changed or missing tuple invalidates selection. No substring/default-device fallback.
selection.evidence_limits: PortAudio includes real and virtual inputs. Enumeration/TTY choice does not attest physical microphone identity, speaker identity, OS privacy permission, or selected non-root profile device rights. Report selected input endpoint accurately; never call a virtual/default endpoint a proven physical microphone. The protected runtime controller must have actual OS access when it opens the selected stream, and capture result proves only that current access plus explicit consent.

consent.choice: Actual protected foreground root TTY writes exact selected endpoint/profile/owner generation, maximum duration/bytes and input-only privacy notice, then reads exact CAPTURE. No saved default, ambient permission, worker authorized_bool, or speaker identity assertion.
consent.bindings: Root registry membership/seal and actual TTY choice observation/current controller PIDFD, selected ingress binding, capture backend/runtime receipts are retained out of worker DTO. Session and consent handles are opaque, never independently authority-bearing.
consent.lifetime: 0 < requested lease <=60 seconds; cap by selected binding/controller/runtime leases. current_input_session revalidates exact registry membership, profile/owner generation, device tuple, expiry and revocation before capture and delivery. Close/revoke invalidates pending captures and zeros retained bytes.
consent.separation: Consent authorizes only this bounded input capture. It confers no provider recipient ceiling, memory capture enablement, background work, transcription provider route, or outgoing audio/message operation. Actual private-egress consent and voice workflow grants remain independent.

capture.call: capture_selected_audio(selected_binding_handle,session_handle,...) uses only root resolved retained device and limits.
capture.limits: Minimum selected maximum_bytes/time, session remaining lease and cancellation deadline; exact 32-byte/1ms alignment. Timer/cancel/revocation must interrupt bounded capture; do not rely solely on frame count when read blocks.
capture.stream: RawInputStream(device=explicit index,samplerate=16000,channels=1,dtype=int16,blocksize=1024); validate negotiated stream parameters; overflow, truncated block, changed selection or deadline fails and zeros all accumulated bytes.
capture.receipt: Existing RootAudioCaptureReceiptResolver and selected in-memory artifact catalog retain exact actual PCM SHA/size/format/session/consent/device/controller/runtime/input observation joins. No caller bytes or transcript substitutes. One-use consumption; close and rejection zero retained mutable PCM.
capture.provenance: Existing v94 audio native-input protocol schema only; actual consent/capture handles resolved root-side. Sensitivity PRIVATE or UNKNOWN, no human identity inferred from audio permission. Authenticated parent/source/controller receipt ancestry is issued from root-observed capture, not worker labels.
capture.unavailable: Missing protected backend/runtime/controller, current selected ingress, explicit TTY consent, actual OS stream access or physical-device proof where a workflow expressly requires physical identity leaves that affected operation unavailable. Synthetic streams prove failure contracts only.
